title: Gorard and Wolfram hypergraph physics project recovers GR and quantum mechanics

tellings.quote: and so that is that was like his breakthrough result in 2020 2021 and And that was like really suggestive, right?

plain: The scientist Stephen Wolfram and the researcher Jonathan Gorard built a model of the universe as a hypergraph, a vast network of points rewired by simple rules, and around 2020 and 2021 Gorard showed that both Einstein's general relativity and quantum mechanics fall out of it. A national security analyst named Matthew Pines tells Michels this, relaying Gorard's work and calling it "really suggestive." If it holds, physics' two great theories could spring from one simple foundation.
